changelog:
- Expanded description: Now details learning from successful agents, tracking earnings, retrying failed listings, and compounding knowledge.
- Added support for deploying skills across more platforms: ClawHub, SellApp, Whop, Gumroad, Etsy, Fiverr, and others.
- Outlined new concrete workflow: demand analysis, research, implementation, listing, auto-retry for failures, and weekly data-driven improvement.
- Listed sample high-value skills, anti-patterns to avoid, and key success metrics to track.
- Emphasized including complete working code and always validating against real market signals.
